description: This file contains code to run and interact with a MockServer instance, including starting the server, creating expectations, verifying requests, retrieving recorded requests and logs, clearing expectations, and resetting the server.

methods.name: runMockServer
methods.description: Starts the mock server with specified configuration and logs the status.

methods.name: createExpectation
methods.description: Creates a mock response expectation for the server.

methods.name: createExpectationOverTLS
methods.description: Creates a mock response expectation over TLS.

methods.name: verifyRequestsExact
methods.description: Verifies that a request with a specific path was received exactly 2 times.

methods.name: verifyRequestsReceiveAtLeastTwice
methods.description: Verifies that a request with a specific path was received at least 2 times.

methods.name: verifyRequestsReceiveAtMostTwice
methods.description: Verifies that a request with a specific path was received at most 2 times.

methods.name: verifyRequestsReceiveExactlyTwice
methods.description: Verifies that a request with a specific path was received exactly 2 times.

methods.name: verifyRequestsReceiveAtLeastTwiceByOpenAPI
methods.description: Verifies requests matching an OpenAPI spec were received at least twice.

methods.name: verifyRequestsReceiveExactlyOnceByOpenAPIWithOperation
methods.description: Verifies a specific OpenAPI operation was called exactly once.

methods.name: verifyRequestsReceiveExactlyOnceByExpectationIds
methods.description: Verifies a request by expectation ID was received exactly once.

methods.name: verifyRequestSequence
methods.description: Verifies a sequence of requests occurred in the specified order.

methods.name: verifyRequestSequenceUsingOpenAPI
methods.description: Verifies a sequence of requests matching OpenAPI spec in order.

methods.name: verifyRequestSequenceUsingExpectationIds
methods.description: Verifies a sequence of requests by expectation IDs in order.

methods.name: retrieveRecordedRequests
methods.description: Retrieves recorded requests matching criteria.

methods.name: retrieveRecordedLogMessages
methods.description: Retrieves log messages from the server.

methods.name: clearWithRequestPropertiesMatcher
methods.description: Clears expectations matching specific request properties.

methods.name: clearWithOpenAPIRequestMatcher
methods.description: Clears expectations matching an OpenAPI request.

methods.name: clearWithExpectationId
methods.description: Clears expectation by ID.

methods.name: clearRequestsAndLogsWithRequestPropertiesMatcher
methods.description: Clears requests and logs matching request properties.

methods.name: clearRequestAndLogsWithOpenAPIRequestMatcher
methods.description: Clears requests and logs matching OpenAPI request.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets all server state.
